about: Facet bench budgets per device (facet-153). tools/bench.mjs measures each case in the WASM build at the device's size, then estimates the panel's render ms = WASM render ms x the device's factor. The factor is fitted on every run from the anchors: real /fw/perf numbers measured on the panel for scenarios the bench also runs (median of device ms / WASM ms). Budgets are PROVISIONAL (2026-10-22): calibrate from the panels once the firmware bench endpoint exists (README 'Bench').

rules.fps: est fps = min(loop cap, redraw rate, 1000 / est render ms) while the case redraws; over budget when < fps_min
rules.frame_ms: est render ms p95 (WASM p95 x factor) over frame_ms_max
rules.idle: a case not marked live must not redraw in its idle window (px per s over idle_px_per_s)
rules.build: first build + first frame, est (WASM x factor) over build_ms_max
rules.heap: heap growth for the case (after settle minus the empty stage) over heap_kb_max; WASM malloc, a proxy for LVGL heap on the panel
rules.objs: LVGL objects on the display over objs_max
